events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off on this day in 1969, bringing together nearly half a million people for three days of peace and music.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. What's your favourite memory or performance from the legendary festival?

events.title: Elvis Presley Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. His music still moves us like no other. What's your top Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The formidable Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', her voice is unmistakable.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in London in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 and all his adventures. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
